name: Gudai Global (Beauty of Joseon)
corridor_involvement: The one independent K-brand that has actually landed on the Indian access rail. Blinkit (2026-07-23) shows 4 SKUs in stock, premium skincare only, Rs1,400-1,570 — the only non-conglomerate brand in the 'stocked deep' group. Its Relief Sunscreen SPF50+ carries MRP Rs1,570 with a Nykaa sale price of Rs1,256 (20% off), recorded as a category bestseller and promo-dependent. Also carried in Flipkart's 2025 international K-beauty portfolio.
read: KRW 184.1bn of production value, +68.6% (MFDS, MEDIUM), and the proof case that an independent K-brand can reach Indian q-commerce without a conglomerate parent or an exclusive platform deal. But it landed at the top of the ladder, not the middle: Rs1,400-1,570 shelf prices sit well above the mid-price derma band the corridor whitespace identifies, and the sunscreen's bestseller status is explicitly promo-dependent at 20% off. It shows the route is passable while leaving the actual whitespace — masstige derma into Tier 2/3 — unfilled.
